info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Cancel QR Payment Request API
info.description: The Cancel QR Payment Request API enables users to effectively manage and cancel payment requests that are generated via QR codes. This API allows businesses to quickly revoke pending transactions, ensuring optimal control over financial operations. Typical consumers include payment processors, e-commerce platforms, and financial service providers looking to enhance their payment management capabilities. Using this endpoint, developers can programmatically cancel requests by specifying the unique payment request identifier.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel an existing QR payment request identified by its unique ID. Ensure that the request is cancellable and that you have the necessary permissions to perform this action.

requestBody.description: Request body for canceling a specific QR payment request identified by PAY-300045. This operation allows the user to cancel a pending payment request.
